about_the_game:
Survivors Last Stand is a rogue-like action shoot 'em up game. Kill aliens to upgrade your weapons. Harvest gems to unlock permanent upgrades or just reroll a new hand of cards to choose from. Create wild combinations of weapons and abilities for crazy builds with each playthrough!

This demo includes 1 of 4 playable characters and the first of 4 stages.
